description: This file defines the 'Project' result class for the Coocook schema, including database table mapping, relationships, and methods for project management such as archiving, unarchiving, and related data retrieval.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Project
classes.description: Represents the 'projects' table in the database, encapsulating project data and relationships, with methods for project lifecycle and related data access.

methods.name: archive
methods.description: Archives the project by setting the 'archived' timestamp to current time; throws an error if already archived.

methods.name: unarchive
methods.description: Unarchives the project by clearing the 'archived' timestamp; throws an error if not archived.

methods.name: dishes
methods.description: Retrieves dishes associated with the project via related meals.

methods.name: articles_cached_units
methods.description: Fetches articles and units related to the project, caching their relationships for efficient access.

methods.name: dish_ingredients
methods.description: Shortcut method to retrieve ingredients from dishes within the project.

methods.name: inventory
methods.description: Returns a hashref with counts of related objects such as articles, dishes, meals, etc.

methods.name: is_stale
methods.description: Determines if the project is considered stale based on a pivot date, indicating if it can be archived.

methods.name: tags_from_names
methods.description: Retrieves tags matching given names; may be extended to auto-create missing tags.

methods.name: organizations_without_permission
methods.description: Finds organizations not associated with the project.

methods.name: other_projects
methods.description: Retrieves all projects except the current one.

methods.name: users_without_permission
methods.description: Finds users not associated with the project.
